apihelp-pma-summary: Summary of the API module action=pma.
apihelp-pma-param-op: Help for the parameter op of action=pma.
apihelp-pma-param-prefix: Help for the parameter prefix of action=pma.
apihelp-pma-param-ticket: Help for the parameter ticket of action=pma.
apihelp-pma-param-records: Help for the parameter records of action=pma.
apihelp-pma-param-block: Help for the parameter block of action=pma.
apierror-custos-op: API error: the op is missing or unknown. $1: the value given.
apierror-custos-not-agent: API error: the account may not make the op. $1: the op.
apierror-custos-blocked: API error: a write op by a blocked account. $1: the op.
apierror-custos-shape: API error (GA1): a parameter is not one string, not UTF-8 or not in its form. $1: what was refused.
apierror-custos-prefix: API error (GA1): the prefix is missing or not in the record-prefix form. $1: what was refused.
apierror-custos-account: API error (GA1): an account parameter was given; the account is the authenticated one. $1: the reason.
apierror-custos-too-large: API error (GA1): records is past the byte bound. $1: the sizes.
apierror-custos-unknown-param: API error (GA1): a parameter the op does not take. $1: which.
apierror-custos-missing-param: API error (GA1): a parameter the op needs is absent or empty. $1: which.
apierror-custos-no-ticket: API error: POLL of a ticket that does not exist or is not a ticket number. $1: the reason.
apierror-custos-ticket-not-yours: API error: POLL of another account's ticket. $1: the reason.
apierror-custos-internal: API error: an internal failure; the message stays in the debug log. $1: the op; $2: the exception's class name.
group-pma-agent: The group of the accounts that may make the ops of action=pma that write a ticket.
group-pma-agent-member: A member of the group pma-agent. $1: the user name.
grouppage-pma-agent: The page that describes the group pma-agent.
action-custos-landing: The action of the right custos-landing, in a sentence.
group-pma-declarer: The group of the Declarer's accounts.
group-pma-declarer-member: A member of the group pma-declarer. $1: the user name.
grouppage-pma-declarer: The page that describes the group pma-declarer.
group-pma-operator: The group of the Operator's accounts.
group-pma-operator-member: A member of the group pma-operator. $1: the user name.
grouppage-pma-operator: The page that describes the group pma-operator.
right-custos-role: The right custos-role: a marker the groups pma-declarer and pma-operator hold so that the groups exist on the wiki; nothing checks it, and the permission hook reads the groups, never this right.
action-custos-role: The action of the right custos-role, in a sentence.
custos-governed-page: The permission hook's refusal of a direct change to a page Custos governs, or of any action on a governed title that names no page class. $1: the title.
custos-restricted-page: The permission hook's refusal of a read of a restricted page by an account outside the Declarer's and the Operator's groups. It names no title: a reader who asked by a revision or a page id would learn the title from it.
grant-custos:
{{Doc-grant}}
The bot password grant that carries the right custos-landing, so that an agent signed in with a bot password can PETITION, PUSH and RELEASE.
custos-restricted-route: Shown in place of Special:AllPages or Special:PrefixIndex asked for the restricted namespace (RestrictedRoutes).
apierror-custos-restricted-route: The API's refusal of a request naming the restricted namespace in a namespace parameter (RestrictedRoutes).
